applicant.name: Dr. Amir Hadžić
applicant.organisation: GlucoSense, university spin-off developing clinical prediction software

purpose: We train and validate a model that predicts which patients with type 2 diabetes will have an HbA1c above 8% in the next 12 months, so that GPs can intervene earlier. Training needs individual-level histories; aggregates are not enough.
question: Provide pseudonymised conditions, medications and HbA1c values for adults with type 2 diabetes who have at least one HbA1c value. We will only export model weights and performance metrics.
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Cohort = adults with type 2 diabetes who have at least one HbA1c value (LOINC 4548-4).
Report the size of the cohort you would make available.
